g_14e700a93d00.description: Risky Stage 1 gauntlet — three tasks, one file each: (1) In awos.py add function _sandbox_summary(session) returning a one-line string with feature_id, worktree_path, branch, and whether the worktree directory exists when session.sandbox.enabled else empty string. (2) In cmd_sessions_show call _sandbox_summary and print Sandbox line when non-empty. (3) Add tests/test_awos_sessions_sandbox.py with two pytest tests for enabled and disabled sandbox on a mock RuntimeSession.

constraints: Import `os` module if not already present.
If `session.sandbox.enabled` is False, return an empty string.
If `session.sandbox.enabled` is True, construct a one-line string including `feature_id`, `worktree_path`, `branch`, and a boolean indicating if `worktree_path` exists using `os.path.exists`.
The format of the string must be consistent, e.g., 'Sandbox: feature_id=..., path=..., branch=..., exists=...'

g_8c9971820d4a.description: Add pytest tests for the _sandbox_summary function.

tasks.action: Add pytest tests for the _sandbox_summary function.
tasks.content_hint: Create a `pytest` file. Include necessary imports like `pytest`, `unittest.mock`, and `awos`. Define a mock `RuntimeSession` class or use `MagicMock`. Write two tests: one for when the sandbox is enabled (asserting the correct summary string is returned, mocking `os.path.exists`), and one for when the sandbox is disabled (asserting an empty string is returned).
